post.description: Rebrokering catalog: the full set of offers your app may serve to a given end user, to render on your own surface. Two hard, server-enforced filters always apply: entitlement (your app's opt-outs + whitelist) and geo (offers not redeemable in the end user's country are dropped: non-redeemable offers are never returned). Serve path requires `userId` (a stable end-user identifier) and geo (`countryCode`, or the end user's IP forwarded via X-Forwarded-For); missing either is a 400. Each returned creative carries a tokenized `clickUrl`: route the end user there on tap and it records an attributed transaction (bound to your app, the offer, the creative, and the userId) then 302s to the advertiser. Filter to your curated offer IDs and order CLIENT-SIDE, falling back to other returned offers so your surface is never empty (the server does not narrow to your picks). Set `includeAllRegions: true` for config-time discovery of your full addressable inventory (skips geo, needs no userId, returns no clickUrls; each offer carries targetCountries); not for display. Authentication: publishable key (X-API-Key: pk_live_* / pk_test_*).

userId.description: Stable identifier for the END USER you are rendering offers to (any opaque string; does not need to be PII). REQUIRED on the serve path — it is bound into each offer's clickUrl so a click records a transaction attributed to (your app, the offer, the creative, this user), and it drives per-user fraud controls (trial caps, retake blocking) at click time. Use the same value across renders for the same user. Not required when includeAllRegions is set (config mode returns no clickUrls).

clientId.description: Optional identifier for the operator/sub-publisher on whose behalf offers are shown. Carried through as an analytics dimension. Defaults to userId when omitted.

countryCode.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code of the END USER the offers will be shown to (e.g. "US", "GB"). Provides the geography signal for geo-filtering. Resolution: this value → client IP (X-Forwarded-For aware) → (rejected if neither resolves). Send it when calling server-to-server without forwarding the end user's IP; omit it when the end user (or a proxy forwarding their IP) is the caller. Ignored when includeAllRegions is true.

platform.description: Optional device family of the END USER the offers will be shown to (enum; any other value is rejected with 400). Analytics dimension only (platform on the serve event); never 'api'.

placementId.description: Optional publisher-defined label for the surface this offer is shown on (e.g. 'cancel_flow', 'home_feed', 'post_purchase'). Stamped onto the impression AND onto the click it produces, so publisher analytics can break the funnel out by placement. Normalised server-side: a blank value is treated as absent, anything longer than 64 characters is TRUNCATED rather than rejected, and the stored label NEVER carries leading or trailing whitespace — including after truncation, so ' my label ' and 'my label' are always one placement and can never show up as two rows. Case IS significant: 'Cancel_Flow' and 'cancel_flow' are different placements. Omit it and this traffic groups under '(unlabeled)' — the same bucket as an SDK integration that supplies no placement.

includeAllRegions.description: CONFIG-TIME ONLY. When true, skips geo-filtering and returns the full addressable inventory for your app (entitlement still applies), with each offer's targetCountries — use this to build your curation. Do NOT use for offers displayed to an end user; those must come from a geo-scoped request (countryCode or forwarded IP). When true, no geography signal is required and countryCode is ignored.

limit.description: Optional page size (1..100). OMIT to return ALL eligible offers (the default) — catalogs are small enough that you normally take the whole set and curate client-side. Provide only if you want to page (with offset).

offset.description: Pagination offset (default 0). Only meaningful together with limit.

perk.description: User-facing value proposition, e.g., "3 months of Hulu free". Rendered in the deal email.

badgeLabel.description: Constrained promo badge for in-app offer cards: free_trial | discount. Drives the card pill display AND client-side free-trial-vs-discount logic. Clients map the enum to display text + free-trial boolean. NULL means no badge.

isDemo.description: When true, this is a demo offer: a fictional brand served only to pk_test_* keys so an integration can be exercised end to end without contacting a real advertiser. Surface it as such rather than presenting it as real inventory. Absent or false means ordinary inventory.

supportedPlatforms.description: Platforms this creative supports (empty = all platforms)

clickUrl.description: Tokenized click URL for THIS creative. Send the end user here when they tap the offer: it records a transaction attributed to (your app, this offer, this creative, the userId you supplied) and 302-redirects to the advertiser with the transaction id substituted. Treat it as opaque, do not modify it. Present on serve responses; absent when includeAllRegions is set.

offers.description: Offers this app is entitled to and (unless includeAllRegions) that are redeemable in the resolved end-user country, each with the default (control-variant) active creatives — never experiment-reserved ones. On serve responses each creative carries a `clickUrl` for attribution. Filter to your curated IDs and order client-side; fall back within this set so your surface is never empty.

total.description: Total offers matching after entitlement + geo filtering (before pagination).

hasMore.description: Whether more offers remain beyond this page.

locale.description: Resolved locale served in this response (language-only, e.g. 'es').

post.description: DEPRECATED (2026-08-24): kept serving for existing integrators; new integrations use /offers/feed. Select one eligible offer for a third-party messaging surface (WhatsApp, Messenger, Instagram) and return the raw offer fields, the branded short clickUrl plus context (title, description, imageUrl, advertiserName, perk), so the integrator composes their own message. Calling this endpoint is NOT itself the impression: it emits sdk_offer_requested and returns impressionUid; confirm display via POST /offers/impressions/{impressionUid}/delivered once the message is delivered. Authentication: publishable key (X-API-Key: pk_live_* / pk_test_*). Retries are NOT deduplicated server-side (no retry-stable client key on the request), so each call produces a distinct short link and analytics row.

clientId.description: Stable identifier for the integrator-client (the business / operator the message is being sent on behalf of). Carried through as an analytics dimension so impressions, clicks, and conversions can be broken down per client.

chatId.description: Conversation / thread identifier on the messaging platform. Used as the messaging-surface userId — drives bandit seeding for `/offers/message`, the transaction created at click time, and the userId dimension on the click event.

language.description: BCP 47 language tag — drives creative locale resolution (e.g., 'en', 'es').

platform.description: Recipient's device platform — drives creative compatibility filtering. Optional: omit for a platform='api' app to receive all eligible offers untrimmed; device-SDK apps always send it. 'api' is not a valid value here.

attributes.description: Targeting attributes — countryCode and language are required; platform is optional (omit for a platform='api' app to receive all offers untrimmed).

placementId.description: Optional publisher-defined label for the surface this offer is shown on (e.g. 'cancel_flow', 'home_feed', 'post_purchase'). Stamped onto the impression AND onto the click it produces, so publisher analytics can break the funnel out by placement. Normalised server-side: a blank value is treated as absent, anything longer than 64 characters is TRUNCATED rather than rejected, and the stored label NEVER carries leading or trailing whitespace — including after truncation, so ' my label ' and 'my label' are always one placement and can never show up as two rows. Case IS significant: 'Cancel_Flow' and 'cancel_flow' are different placements. Omit it and this traffic groups under '(unlabeled)' — the same bucket as an SDK integration that supplies no placement.

impressionUid.description: Handle for the served offer; POST /offers/impressions/{impressionUid}/delivered when the message is confirmed delivered to the user (that call is the impression). Absent when no offer was served.

clickUrl.description: Branded short click URL (https://link.encorekit.com/<slug>) that 302s to the advertiser with attribution. Short enough to send as raw text on messaging surfaces.

description.description: Longer creative description, or null when the creative has none.

advertiserName.description: Display name of the advertiser (organization) behind the offer.

isDemo.description: When true, this is a demo offer: a fictional brand served only to pk_test_* keys so an integration can be exercised end to end without contacting a real advertiser. Surface it as such rather than presenting it as real inventory. Absent or false means ordinary inventory.

perk.description: Campaign value proposition (e.g. "3 months of Apple Music free"), or null when the campaign has none. Surfaced explicitly so integrators can render the deal in the message they compose.

badgeLabel.description: Constrained promo badge for the in-app offer card: "free_trial" | "discount", or null when the campaign has none. Distinct from perk (longer value proposition). Clients map the enum to display text ("Free trial" / "Discount") and free-trial-vs-discount logic. Surfaced additively.

offer.description: Selected offer details — the branded short clickUrl plus context fields — for the integrator to compose and send their own message, or null when no eligible offer was found. No message is composed server-side.

post.description: Return the bandit-ranked eligible offers for a user (up to `limit`, default 10) so a native / custom-UI app can render them and cycle through them client-side. Each offer carries its own impressionUid plus the branded short clickUrl and context (title, description, imageUrl, additionalImages, advertiserName, advertiserLogo, perk). Calling this endpoint is NOT itself the impression: the server emits one sdk_offer_requested per offer as the requests baseline; confirm an actual impression by calling POST /offers/impressions/:impression_uid/delivered when an offer is shown. Returns offers:[] when no eligible offer was found. Authentication: publishable key (X-API-Key: pk_live_* / pk_test_*).

clientId.description: Stable identifier for the integrator-client (the business / operator the offer is rendered on behalf of). Carried through as an analytics dimension so impressions, clicks, and conversions can be broken down per client.

userId.description: End-user identifier on the partner surface. Used as the bandit-seeding userId for ranking and as the userId on the transaction created at click time.

language.description: BCP 47 language tag — drives creative locale resolution (e.g., 'en', 'es').

platform.description: Recipient's device platform — drives creative compatibility filtering. Optional: omit for a platform='api' app to receive all eligible offers untrimmed; device-SDK apps always send it. 'api' is not a valid value here.

attributes.description: Targeting attributes — countryCode and language are required; platform is optional (omit for a platform='api' app to receive all offers untrimmed).

limit.description: Maximum number of offers to return (1–25, default 10). The client controls display order and cycles through them one at a time.

placementId.description: Optional publisher-defined label for the surface this offer is shown on (e.g. 'cancel_flow', 'home_feed', 'post_purchase'). Stamped onto the impression AND onto the click it produces, so publisher analytics can break the funnel out by placement. Normalised server-side: a blank value is treated as absent, anything longer than 64 characters is TRUNCATED rather than rejected, and the stored label NEVER carries leading or trailing whitespace — including after truncation, so ' my label ' and 'my label' are always one placement and can never show up as two rows. Case IS significant: 'Cancel_Flow' and 'cancel_flow' are different placements. Omit it and this traffic groups under '(unlabeled)' — the same bucket as an SDK integration that supplies no placement.

impressionUid.description: Per-offer impression id. Pass this to POST /offers/impressions/:impression_uid/delivered when this offer is actually shown to the user to record the impression.

clickUrl.description: Branded short click URL (https://link.encorekit.com/<slug>) that 302s to the advertiser with attribution. Open it in-app to register the click; also usable as a share-to-friend link.

campaignId.description: Stable identifier for the offer (campaign). Use THIS to match a completion back to the offer you displayed: the `offer_completed` webhook carries the same value as its `campaignId`. Unlike `title` (which is per-creative and localized) and `campaignName` (an editable admin label), this never changes for a given offer.

description.description: Longer creative description, or null when the creative has none.

additionalImages.description: Additional creative image URLs (may be empty). Supplements the primary imageUrl.

isDemo.description: When true, this is a demo offer: a fictional brand served only to pk_test_* keys so an integration can be exercised end to end without contacting a real advertiser. Surface it as such rather than presenting it as real inventory. Absent or false means ordinary inventory.

advertiserName.description: Display name of the advertiser (organization) behind the offer.

advertiserLogo.description: Advertiser (organization) logo URL for rendering the brand mark, or null when the advertiser has no logo set.

perk.description: Campaign value proposition (e.g. "3 months of Apple Music free"), or null when the campaign has none.

badgeLabel.description: Constrained promo badge for the in-app offer card: "free_trial" | "discount", or null when the campaign has none. Clients map the enum to display text ("Free trial" / "Discount") and free-trial-vs-discount logic.

offers.description: The bandit-ranked eligible offers for the user (up to `limit`), each with its own impressionUid and branded short clickUrl. Empty array when no eligible offer was found.

post.description: Confirms an impression: call once per offer as it is displayed, for /offers/feed, /offers/catalog and /offers/message alike; the impression id comes from the serve response or the click url. Emits sdk_offer_presented keyed on the impression id; analytics stitches it to the serve in the warehouse. Authentication: publishable key (X-API-Key: pk_live_* / pk_test_*).

deliveredTimestamp.description: Unix seconds — Meta webhook `statuses[].timestamp` where status='delivered'. Milliseconds are also accepted (any value above 1e11 is read as milliseconds), and a value that is not plausibly a real delivery is replaced by the receipt time on the analytics event; the value you send is always preserved verbatim in the event's properties.

readTimestamp.description: Unix seconds — Meta webhook `statuses[].timestamp` where status='read'. Optional. Milliseconds are also accepted, exactly as for `deliveredTimestamp`. Unlike `deliveredTimestamp` there is no receipt-time substitution: a value that is not plausibly a real read is simply reported as null on the analytics event, since nothing depends on it.

get.description: Get unified SDK configuration including SDUI, entitlements, experiments, and remote config. This endpoint replaces /ui-config with a cleaner structure. Entitlement mode is implicit: if entitlements.iap.productId exists, use IAP mode; otherwise use Native mode. Pass `useCase` to configure a surface other than churn-intervention; the response echoes it as ui.useCase. Requesting a surface is all it takes to be served it — no setup call is required. A surface Encore has explicitly switched off for this app, or one with no variant available, returns ui.template: null — clients must no-op, never reuse another use case's template.

parameters.description: User ID for deterministic variant/cohort assignment

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Optional language hint (e.g. 'es'). Overrides the Accept-Language header; region subtags are stripped.

parameters.name: useCase
parameters.description: Which Encore surface is being configured. Omit for today's behaviour. Requesting a surface is all it takes to be served it — no setup call is required. A surface Encore has explicitly switched off for this app, or one with no variant available, resolves to template: null — it NEVER falls back to another use case's template.

useCases.description: NEW, additive. Default variant for every OTHER use case this app is enabled for, so the SDK can cache them at identify(). `ui` is unchanged; un-upgraded decoders ignore this key.

productId.description: Store-level subscription product ID. App Store Connect product ID for iOS apps, Google Play subscription product ID for Android apps.

offerId.description: Google Play subscription offer ID (e.g. 'free-trial-1m'). Null or omitted for iOS apps. The Android SDK uses this value to look up the matching SubscriptionOfferDetails in the product's base plan and pass its offer token to Play Billing's BillingFlowParams.setOfferToken().

basePlanId.description: Google Play base plan ID (e.g. 'monthly', 'annual'); null for iOS. Disambiguates products that expose multiple base plans so the Android SDK resolves the correct SubscriptionOfferDetails / price for the intended base plan instead of defaulting to the first one.

premiumTierName.description: Display name for the premium tier (e.g. 'Premium', 'Pro'). Used in SDUI templates via ${premiumTierName}.

iap.description: IAP config. If productId exists → IAP mode.

durationDays.description: Computed duration in days for SDK logic

native.description: Native/Encore-managed entitlement. Fallback if no IAP.

enabled.description: Kill switch. If false, all users go to Control.

Create a lead for async advertiser email capture

trialDurationDays.description: Trial length in days as reported by StoreKit; drives reminder scheduling.

transactionId.description: Client-issued UUID v4 used as the conversion attribution id; substituted into the sponsor URL at email-send time.

useCase.description: Which Encore surface the user claimed from. Persisted on the transaction this route creates, so the server-side completion — built from that row alone, with no client context — can be split by use case, along with the payout booked on it. Absent means 'churn-intervention'.

post.description: Record a tester reveal ping (5-shake gesture). Used to surface the device user ID in the admin portal so a tester can be added to experiment_overrides without log access.

userId.description: SDK-assigned user ID. Same value the SDK sends as ?userId= to /config.

appAccountId.description: Persistent person-level identifier (Apple appTransactionID on iOS). Nullable on iOS<16 / unverified.

sdkVersion.description: SDK version that fired the reveal.

post.description: Create a redemption claim for a partner offer. Creates the underlying transaction and a pending redemption.

claimToken.description: Opaque token addressing this redemption (status-page URL + email/SMS)

offerUrl.description: Attributable partner offer link (tracking params appended + TRANSACTION_ID substituted). Raw destination when no tracking params; "" when no destination configured.

post.description: Create a redemption claim and email the user the partner offer link + resumable status link.

claimToken.description: Opaque token addressing this redemption (status-page URL + email/SMS)

offerUrl.description: Attributable partner offer link (tracking params appended + TRANSACTION_ID substituted). Raw destination when no tracking params; "" when no destination configured.

get.description: Get the status of a redemption claim (verifying | ready | redeemed | expired).

partnerLabel.description: Partner offer that unlocks the reward, e.g. "Apple Music"

campaignId.description: Campaign this claim is for — ties a deep-linked claim to its offer card

creative.description: One active creative for the campaign (null if none)

post.description: Acquire/renew the exclusive presentation lease for the ready-to-redeem screen (per deviceId).

granted.description: True when THIS device now holds the exclusive presentation lease

status.description: Wire status of the redemption (same mapping as the status endpoint)

leaseExpiresAt.description: When the granted lease lapses unless renewed (granted only)

heartbeatIntervalSeconds.description: How often the client should re-present to renew the lease (granted only)

lockedByOtherDevice.description: True when ready but the lease is held by another live device

post.description: Release the presentation lease held by this device (per deviceId).
Atomically burn a ready redemption. Dead on every device thereafter.

Mint the creator's shareable affiliate links: one stable branded short link per campaign your app is entitled to serve (every enabled campaign, regardless of geo). Idempotent — the same creatorId always returns the same link per campaign. Each link is a single URL clickable by many people; every distinct click is an independent claim tracked as its own transaction. Authentication: publishable key (X-API-Key: pk_live_* / pk_test_*).

creatorId.description: Publisher-supplied stable identifier for the creator (opaque to Encore).

perk.description: User-facing value proposition, e.g., "3 months of Hulu free". Rendered in the deal email.

badgeLabel.description: Constrained promo badge for in-app offer cards: free_trial | discount. Drives the card pill display AND client-side free-trial-vs-discount logic. Clients map the enum to display text + free-trial boolean. NULL means no badge.

amount.description: Publisher's payout per completion: campaign payout × the app's payout split (raw campaign payout when no split is set).

model.description: Campaign payout model (CPA / CPC / CPI / CPM).

categories.description: The campaign's categories (for offer-wall filter tabs). Empty when the campaign has none.

supportedPlatforms.description: Platforms this creative supports (empty = all platforms)

get.description: Real-time performance for a creator's links, per campaign and per day: clicks (each click = one claim), completions (verified/final-granted conversions), and earnings (after your app's payout split; USD). Returns rolled-up totals plus a per-day series (`daily`). Optional `startDate`/`endDate` (YYYY-MM-DD, UTC, inclusive; start must be <= end) filter everything; absent = all-time. Clicks attribute by transaction date; completions + earnings by completion date. An unknown creatorId returns 200 with empty campaigns/daily and zeroed totals. Authentication: publishable key (X-API-Key: pk_live_* / pk_test_*).

currency.description: ISO-4217 currency for every `earnings` figure. Always USD.

startDate.description: Echoed applied range start (YYYY-MM-DD), present only when supplied.

endDate.description: Echoed applied range end (YYYY-MM-DD), present only when supplied.

clicks.description: Distinct clicks in range (each click mints one transaction).

completions.description: Clicks whose transaction reached a completed status (verified / final_granted) in range.

earnings.description: Creator/publisher's earnings for this campaign in `currency`, after the app's payout split (raw payout sum if no split is set).

daily.description: Per-day series across all campaigns, ascending; days with no activity are omitted. Clicks attributed by transaction created_at (UTC); completions + earnings by completion timestamp (UTC).

post.description: Ingest analytics events (single or batch). Validates with Zod and enqueues to Kafka.
